Paragraph_EN: Hazrat Muhammad (SAW) was an embodiment of justice. He decided all cases brought to him with equity and justice, irrespective of color, creed, or race. Once, a Quraish woman was found guilty of stealing. Some people wanted to save her from punishment in order to protect the honor of the family of the Quraish. They asked Hazrat Usama bin Zaid (RA) to intercede on her behalf. Hazrat Usama requested the Holy Prophet (SAW) to forgive her. The Holy Prophet (SAW) very furiously said, 'Bani Israil was ruined because of this. They applied law to the poor and forgave the rich.'

Paragraph_EN: Chinese New Year is a holiday that celebrates the beginning of a new year according to the traditional Chinese calendar. It is considered one of the most important holidays for Chinese families. The celebration includes family dinners, fireworks, gift exchanges, and traditional decorations like lanterns and red paper cuts representing good luck and prosperity.
